tasks.task: We need to run a quick test render for the "LumenCart Studio" project before the 3pm review today, but only after verifying the server is reachable and that the project still has a default provider set. Please (1) check server status for LumenCart Studio, (2) fetch the project to confirm its default provider is present, (3) submit a new image generation request for that project using the default provider (do NOT pass provider_id), and (4) confirm the generation request was created by fetching it back by id.

success_criteria: hello returns status=ok for project_id jmg_prj_01J8Z1A9M4Q2X7K3T6V8N0B1C
getProject confirms LumenCart Studio is active and has a non-null default_provider_id
generateImage returns a generation_request with a non-empty id and project_id equal to jmg_prj_01J8Z1A9M4Q2X7K3T6V8N0B1C
getGenerationRequest using that id returns the same request record and a valid status field

input.prompt: Quick test render for LumenCart Studio: minimalist product photo of a modern desk lamp on a clean white background, soft studio lighting, high detail, 1024x1024

tasks.task: For the active project “Northwind Merch Visuals” (id: jmg_prj_01J8Z1C2P7H9D3R5W1K6Q8S0T), we’re hitting rate limits on the fast provider. Before today’s 5pm handoff, switch the project’s default provider to the US endpoint (provider id: jmg_prv_01J8Y3TQ4R5S6T7U8V9W0X1Y2), then submit a test image generation using the default provider and confirm the request was created in queued status.

success_criteria: Project jmg_prj_01J8Z1C2P7H9D3R5W1K6Q8S0T has default_provider_id set to jmg_prv_01J8Y3TQ4R5S6T7U8V9W0X1Y2 after the update (as shown by the second getProject).
A new generation request is created for that project via generateImage and returns an id.
The fetched generation request (getGenerationRequest) matches the returned id and has status 'queued' or 'running' (not failed/cancelled).

input.prompt: Test render: simple product mockup on white background, minimal style, no text.

tasks.task: Our EU team needs to run image generations only through the EU endpoint for compliance starting today. Update the project “Saffron Spoon Menu Art” (id: jmg_prj_01J8Z1H3K9T2B6M8Q1D4F7G0J) so its default provider becomes the EU provider (id: jmg_prv_01J8Y3N6D8E1F2G3H4J5K6L7M), then immediately submit one test generation using the project default (do not pass provider_id) and confirm the generation request is queued under that EU provider.

success_criteria: After the update, getProject for jmg_prj_01J8Z1H3K9T2B6M8Q1D4F7G0J shows default_provider_id == jmg_prv_01J8Y3N6D8E1F2G3H4J5K6L7M.
The generateImage call (with provider_id omitted) returns a generation_request whose provider_id == jmg_prv_01J8Y3N6D8E1F2G3H4J5K6L7M.
getGenerationRequest for the returned generation_request.id confirms status is queued or running (i.e., successfully accepted) and provider_id remains the EU provider.
